role: independent research contributor; Amalgam owner alone controls canonical learner
hypothesis: WSP213's direct-weight underperformance partly arises from strict 75% sign-consistency and abs(mean residual)>=1 admission, not just 25%-of-new-address update budget. Filling the identical 25% eligible-address budget by predeclared consensus ranking improves cumulative B0 retention and new pair-group held predictions over strict admission and equally budgeted surprise/random ranking.

design.freeze: This JSON commit is the freeze BEFORE any new WSP214 source code or primary world evaluated.
design.prohibited_cohorts: Never re-evaluate WSP210 invalid primary 21011-14, WSP211 calibration 21101-02, WSP212 consumed 21201-04 or WSP213 primary 21301-04.
design.synthetic_target: Independent hidden rank4 integer factor arrays component sha256('WSP214\0'+seed+'\0'+allele+'\0'+pos+'\0'+dimension).digest()[0] % 7 - 3, target same-allele dot/9. Never expose factors or targets except according to FIT stage.
design.splits: Existing WSP200 canonical whole pair group FIT B0-B3 stage order; held PUBLIC_DEV pair labels only generated after all arms complete B3; original GFP, VALID and RESERVED never opened.
design.initialization: inherited WSP200 hash-signed .01 factors, identical across all arms
design.learning: B0 full 16 coordinate sweeps for non-conventional arms, B1-B3 exactly 2 sweeps of per-arm active address set; identical stage FIT rows. Full-refit conventional 8-sweep plateau checks <=100 at every stage.
arms: strict_original: inherited WSP200 contradiction mode, 0.75 residual sign agreement, abs(mean)>=1 and ceil(25% of new addresses) cap.

budgeted_consensus: for every newly observed address with >=2 distinct observation IDs, choose min(ceil(new_address_count/4), eligible_count); deterministic ranking descending nonzero-sign agreement, then abs(mean residual), then mean absolute residual, then UTF8 address.
budgeted_surprise: exactly same K eligible addresses, sorted by descending mean absolute residual then UTF8 address.
budgeted_random: exactly same K eligible addresses, sorted by sha256('WSP214-RANDOM-v1\0'+stage+'\0'+address), then UTF8 address.
always: inherited WSP200 update all newly observed addresses, 2 sweeps after B0; higher write-count reference only.
no_update: inherited WSP200 original B0 training then no later writes; regression/negative.
full_refit: inherited qualified WSP211 BlockedFullRefit, all cumulative evidence, exact normal equations and plateau; strongest conventional control.
zero: standardized zero readout only; unfitted negative.
design.gate_diagnostic: Before each strict_original B1-B3 update, compute per-address residual using strict model only from current new FIT batch. Record new address count, eligible count (>=2 unique IDs), strictly sign-consistent >=0.75, abs(mean)>=1, intersection eligible and both threshold, full K, original strict selected count. Counts are descriptive, no oracle or held labels.
design.budget: The three budgeted arms match K exactly stage-by-stage and all perform exactly two coordinate sweeps; strict original is allowed fewer writes by design. Full refit is information-matched but NOT compute-matched.

metrics: Numerical cross-OS parity <=1e-8 abs/rel for normalized objective, B0 old knowledge MSE each stage, held PUBLIC_DEV group-weighted RMSE and diagnostic counters; exclude wall and checkpoint hashes from cross-OS numerical parity.

Exact cold restoration with policy-scoped checkpoint envelope, negative cross-policy and corrupted-content restore, staged source SHA, zero new FIT replay, FIT/PUBLIC_DEV disjoint, readout stable after checkpoint.
Per-world all-arm FIT same-evidence identity; budgeted 3-arm selected address count K, 2* K coordinate solves every post-B0 stage; B0 history no-new-data readout.
Aggregate per world candidate improvement over strict, equal-write surprise/random, no_update and qualified full_refit; all limits below frozen pre-outcome.

classification.INVALID: Any comparator nonconvergence, NaN/nonfinite metric, failed policy write parity, numeric OS drift, inconsistent source, leak, cold restore failure, missing world/stage, failed CI/G29 or negative checks; no science conclusion.
classification.GATE_ADVANTAGE: In >=3/4 worlds: budgeted_consensus held RMSE <=0.90*strict_original, <=0.95*full_refit, <=0.95*min(budgeted_surprise,budgeted_random); B3 B0 MSE <=1.05*full_refit B0 MSE; coordinate solves < full_refit. This is only a bounded synthetic positive, never native intelligence.
classification.LOW_ADMISSION_DIAGNOSTIC: At least 8/12 B1-B3 stage diagnostics have original strict selected <=floor(K/2) with K>0, AND consensus beats strict held RMSE by >=10% in >=3 worlds, but GATE_ADVANTAGE false. Supports a bounded update-frequency bottleneck, not strong-control superiority.
classification.UNDERSELECTION_OBSERVED: At least 8/12 B1-B3 stages strict selected <=floor(K/2) with K>0 but neither GATE_ADVANTAGE nor LOW_ADMISSION_DIAGNOSTIC; count-only finding, not evidence of recovered learning.
classification.NO_GAIN: Valid primary but none of above classifications. Preserve negative and null outcomes.
classification.cohort_consumption: Execute each of four synthetic primary worlds one time per OS for numerical verification, not iterative tuning. Retire all 21401-21404 after evaluation.

controls.engineering: Root mandatory full test + WSP200 and WSP209 full + WSP210 smoke + WSP211 allowlist-only + WSP212 source-only + WSP213 source-only + WSP214 source-only on Windows/Linux Python3.12. G29 pinned source seal before any new primary.

limits: Synthetic pair-group transfer only (not new causal-law family); full-refit receives more compute; direct-weight gate mechanisms are mathematical design candidates, not native Yggdrasil trained cognition; preserve nulls and do not modify earlier frozen cohorts.
